findings.source_quote: He was at the crossroads, all his life as a whole.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the second clause with «وكان عند مفترق طرق حياته كلها» to convey that the crossroads concerns his life as a whole, without adding that his life was at stake.
findings.translation_quote: كان عند مفترق الطرق، وكانت حياته كلها على المحك.
